title: Be SURE to check INSIDE and all pieces carefully
text: Be SURE to check INSIDE and all pieces carefully. This piece is absolutely beautiful, but had several quality control issues.  When delivered, you inspect the item as best you can curbside, but upon getting ready to set up, discovered after unwrapping both shelves, they were chipped in corners and damaged.  The inside of one drawer had the same chipped/scrape issues in a corner.  All hardware screws seem to be stripped, but come with extra screws.  Some other minor installation hardware missing a few pieces.  AMAZON was notified and resolved issues immediately.  Beautiful product, but be sure to inspect carefully as there are definitely quality control issues.
